en:
<CLT=cltMIND>So the poison played a role in
this killing game after all...

<CLT=cltMIND>Miu just used it as a diversion,
but next time...

<CLT=cltMIND>...No! There can't be a next time!
I've had enough of this!

<CLT=cltMIND>From the look of this door...
it must be an <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate lab<CLT=cltMIND>.
<CLT=cltMIND>...Whose lab is this?

<CLT=cltMIND>There are only a few of us left
who don't have a lab yet...
I should check inside.
<CLT=cltMIND>When I turned the knob...
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>*click...click...*
Huh? It won't open...

Oh, that research lab is closed because
its owner is dead!
...The owner is dead?

Per the rules, if a student dies before their
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate research lab<CLT=cltNORMAL> is opened...
...then that lab will remain closed.
That's the first time I'm hearing this!

That's cuz this is the first time I've mentioned
it.

<CLT=cltMIND>...There's no point in complaining
to Monokuma. This is his academy.

<CLT=cltMIND>Anyway...
If this lab belongs to someone who died...
Is this...Rantaro's lab?

How disappointing. You'd know what his
talent was if you went in his lab.

Puhuhu... It'd be quite a dramatic development
if you learned what his talent was right now!
Wh-What does that mean?
Yes, what does that mean?

That sorta unexpected development can only
happen in a real killing game like this one.

Oh well, what a waste. I can't believe that
idiot killed him.

<CLT=cltMIND>Rantaro's lab...
I am curious about his talent, but...
<CLT=cltMIND>It's too late now.

<CLT=cltMIND>Rantaro's Lab...
I am curious about his talent, but...
<CLT=cltMIND>It's too late now.
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>*click...click...*
Huh? The key works...but it won't turn.
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>*tick, tick, tick, tick!*
...Ticking?

<CLT=cltMIND>Sensing danger, I hurriedly backed away
from the door, and then...
<CLT=cltMIND>It exploded!

<CLT=cltMIND>A trap?
That was dangerous...
I could have really been hurt...

<CLT=cltMIND>The key...it's still here.
Can it be used for something else?
Ah! There you are, Shuichi!

Can you come to the dining hall?
Tsumugi wants us all to meet her there.
Huh? Tsumugi?

She said she found something. I assume
she has found a <CLT=cltSTRONG>Flashback Light<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

At any rate, please hurry!
I shall go on ahead!
<CLT=cltMIND>So we finally found it...

<CLT=cltMIND>The next <CLT=cltSTRONG>Flashback Light<CLT=cltMIND>.
What will we remember this time?
I should head to the dining hall.
